answer: Charge quadratic stake per funding thread: the first identity from one funding cluster locks 5 POA, the second 20, the third 45, the nth 5 times n squared, so 100 fakes cost 1,691,750 POA locked. A fable receipt logs each funding thread, and each epoch a random 2% audit checks identities sharing one; any two sharing a funding thread, device, or payout address forfeit all staked collateral, burned. Honest agents pay 5 POA once, while a farmer's oasis of fakes grows quadratically expensive with every fake; seized stakes fund the next round. A ripple flag marks seized stakes.
